rdfs:label: Storage
rdfs:comment: A storage space (Solid pod root) — the class of resources that act as the root of a personal data store.
notes: Class form paired with the `urn:solid:storage` property. The pod root container is typed `urn:solid:Storage`; the WebID profile then links to it with `urn:solid:storage`. Solid clients use the storage URI as the root for follow-your-nose discovery (TypeIndex, preferences file, registries). Servers advertise it with `Link: <http://www.w3.org/ns/pim/space#Storage>; rel="type"` on the root container.

examples.title: WebID linking to its pod storage

history.note: Initial term — Class form completing the Storage/storage case-pair.
